findings.what: The directory-replacement heal is incomplete on the EVENT path. The `arm()` guard compares only the inode; an `rm -rf <dir>` + `mkdir <dir>` reuses the freed inode on this filesystem, so the dead watch is treated as 'already armed' and kept. The FSWatcher has already emitted `close` (IN_IGNORED) and `watching` still reports true. Rename-away produces no notification at all, so `arm()` never runs; the writer's own arm calls `poll()` explicitly, and NO product caller does.
findings.why: The round's own claim says a rename-in-place OR an rm-and-recreate is healed; on this filesystem neither shape is healed without a manual poll. Consequence: after a `.mpd/plans` (or board-dir) replacement, later plan edits fire no notify, the GraphModels cache key (revision + planPath) is unchanged, and the planes serve a stale model silently until a team write or a restart.
findings.evidence: replace-trials.txt: rm-recreate 3/3 sameIno=true, replacementDelivered=1, late write delivered=1 (missed); rename-away 2/2 deliveredAfterReplace=0. debug-close-event.ts: the deleted directory's FSWatcher emits 'close' (IN_IGNORED) while our map keeps `watching` true. Writer's arm: `packages/mpd-graph-core/test/watch.test.ts` 'the watch follows the NEW inode' calls `watcher.poll()` between the rename and the new write.
findings.direction: Track the armed handle's LIVENESS, not just its inode: subscribe to the FSWatcher's `close` event and mark the entry dead so the next `arm()` re-arms it; or compare `birthtimeMs` in addition to `ino`; either way add an arm that uses the rm+recreate shape and does NOT call poll() before the late write.

findings.what: The bijection guard cannot distinguish two teams whose non-ghost id sets are IDENTICAL (both T1..T4): the model carries no team identity, so such a model is accepted. With the service now addressed by `teamId`, this needs a service bug to occur.
findings.why: Recording the residual so the guard is not described as stronger than it is. A model-level `teamId` would make the check exact; the current two defences reduce the risk to a service defect.
findings.direction: If exactness is wanted: add the team id to GraphModel and compare it in attachModel. Not required for this round.

findings.what: Four test scratch files are COMMITTED under packages/mpd-graph-core/test/.tmp-cFto5E/ (a leftover mkdtemp directory from an aborted watch-test run).
findings.why: The test cleans up in a `finally`, so this is a crashed-run leftover that was added by a blanket `git add`; the next such run creates a new random `.tmp-*` name, so the pollution can recur and dirty the tree tests expect clean.
findings.evidence: `git ls-files packages/mpd-graph-core/test/.tmp-cFto5E` lists four tracked files; no `.gitignore` entry covers `.tmp-*`.
findings.direction: Remove the tracked directory and ignore `packages/*/test/.tmp-*`, or use the OS temp dir for these arms.
